title: “It's up to us to make refilling attractive,” Mandana Vahedi, Planet B
summary: At just 26, Mandana Vahedi has already taken on several major challenges in luxury beauty packaging. After an initial internship at L'Oréal Luxe, she joined Puig in Spain, where she worked on the Carolina Herrera makeup line. She is now a Product Development Project Manager at Planet B, the Belgian company behind WONDR (personal care and beauty) and POWR (laundry and household care). Her mission is to make sustainable choices easy. Mandana Vahedi is among the talents selected for the Future... - Packaging & design / A la une

title: Sol de Janeiro teams up with Brazilian racing driver Aurelia Nobels
summary: Sol de Janeiro has partnered with rising Brazilian racing driver Aurelia Nobels to launch Aurelia Perfume Mist , a limited-edition fragrance inspired by her Brazilian roots and the adrenaline of motorsport. A rising talent in motorsport, Nobels began racing at the age of 10 in Brazil. In 2022, she became the first woman to compete in the Brazilian F4 Championship and won the Senior category of the FIA Girls on Track – Rising Stars program. title: Quadpack unveils packaging collection for the new generation of haircare
summary: Driven by trends such as skinification, premiumisation and hyper-segmentation, the haircare category is moving beyond traditional shampoos and conditioners towards targeted treatments promising stronger, denser and healthier hair, as well as improved scalp health. In response to these changing expectations, Quadpack has developed a collection of packaging solutions for high-performance, targeted and personalised hair treatments.
